constellations.name: The Key-and-Gate
constellations.lore: Doors, pathways, new ways, and sacred wounds.

constellations.name: The Lantern-and-Eye
constellations.lore: The truth that burns; seekers, archivists, and minds that correlate their contents.

constellations.name: The Beating Heart
constellations.lore: Those who do not stop; survival when all melts like wax.

constellations.name: The Duelist’s Mask
constellations.lore: Necessary concealment, necessary roles, and those who perform them.

constellations.name: The Unburnt Book
constellations.lore: Ideas that cannot die; revolutionaries, idealists, devotees, and the prideful.

constellations.name: The Sundered Wolf
constellations.lore: Self-consuming blue fire; those who break unbreakable things, soldiers, and the desperate.

constellations.name: The Hollow Skull
constellations.lore: Death, inevitability, and the conviction of a chosen fate.

constellations.name: The Golden Lion
constellations.lore: Bravery; the powerless and those whose power was foolishly ignored.

constellations.name: The Fiend Engine
constellations.lore: An impossible mechanism; monsters, arcanists, and elaborate plans.

constellations.name: The Soldier-and-Brother
constellations.lore: Beloved enemies; impermissible lovers and those bound to unwinnable causes.

constellations.name: The Falling Leaf
constellations.lore: Purpose fulfilled, return to earth, and the permission to know peace.

constellations.name: The Dreaming Serpent
constellations.lore: Patience, caution, and those who fear their own boldness.

constellations.name: The Stillness
constellations.lore: Tranquility, solidity, purity, and natural phenomena. One of the first stars of Creation.

constellations.name: The Song
constellations.lore: Divergence, counterpoint, fluidity, discord, and mortal endeavors. One of the first stars of Creation.
